raw_sections.summary: ABOUT ME: Detail-oriented and results-driven Financial Operations professional with 3 years of experience in global reconciliation processes. Proven expertise in managing complex corporate action events, resolving aged breaks, and ensuring high-quality data accuracy. Highly skilled in financial accounting and capital market concepts, with a commitment to process improvement and team collaboration. Seeking to apply analytical and problem solving skills to contribute to forward-thinking organization.
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE As a Associate from October 2022 to Sep 2025.
State Street Ltd – Pune - Middle Office Global Reconciliation Process
➢ Completing daily reconciliation activity for assigned funds (Includes Equity, Fixed Income and Corporate action breaks) and ensuring accuracy & Providing documentations that supports Decision making. ➢ Monitoring Equity trades & Fixed Income trades with Custodians across the market (EMEA, APAC, BOSTON) ➢ Responsible to reconcile all type of corporate action events (Mandatory and Voluntary event) ➢ Expertise in calculation of Corporate Actions like Dividend Re-Investments, Rights Issue, Stock Split, Spin Off, Exchange Offer, as per the event information like entitlement, ratios, Prices & liaising with Custodian & Portfolio Managers reports
➢ Posting the ADJUSTMENTS / AMENDMENTS in RKS if required based on corporate action team and Port
Admin Team confirmation.
➢ Monitoring and addressing aged or outstanding breaks to respective team with root cause investigation on daily
basis and ensure to resolve the breaks on timely manner with proper follow-ups and escalations ➢ Well versed with Recon Applications like TLM, TLP, MCH, PRKS, RKSE, IMT, other custody websites.
➢ Daily review of Comments performed by Reconciler & reporting it to Managment. ➢ Interacting with Internal / External / Custodian / Port Admin / Corporate Action / Trade Admin team to get
resolution for the outstanding exceptions.
➢ Responsible for QC (Quality Checks) . ➢ Handling all type of recon issues i.e. feed flows, setup fund addition deletion issues ➢ Providing trainings to new
Joiners to help them to understand process, application
As a Associate from March 2026 to Till date
Transcom– Gurgaon – Clearing and settlement associate.
➢ Managed broker-to-broker or broker-to-bank securities transfers, both transfer-in and transfer-out on a free of
payment basis, utilizing SWIFT message types MT540 and MT542, and leveraged the Clearstream Exact platform for manual matching to facilitate settlement."
➢ CBF/CBL Realignment via Xact. → Process to realign operational process positions between Clearstream Banking
Frankfurt/Luxembourg systems using Xact.
➢ On settlement date, ensure Sell instructions are released into the market. Failure to release leads to undelivered
trades, buy-in risk and delayed cash credit.
➢ → Reconcile internal aggregates with external settlement partner data the day after trade date. Goal to avoid
unmatched instructions that cause settlement delays, fail fees or buy-in costs.
➢ → Daily reconciliation of internal transaction records against Custodian report (MT536). Breaks must be
investigated; either custodian cancels the message or TR books the missing entry.
raw_sections.skills:
SKILLS and ABILITIES
➢ Strategic Decision-Making and Problem Solving ➢ Building Strong Client Relationships ➢ Adaptability to New Work Environments ➢ Openness to Innovative Ideas and Continuous Learning ➢ Reliability and Punctuality ➢ Effective Leadership Abilities ➢ Mentoring and Training New Team Members ➢ Exceptional Communication Skills

Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Finance Pune University, Sinhagad Business School Graduation Year 2022. Bachelor of Commerce (B.COM) Aurangabad University, Balbhim College Graduation Year 2020.
